prompt_injection_memory.note: See tests/integration/test_memory_prompt_injection.py for the full, automated proof. This shows the sync-time shape only — a malicious memory_prompt is stored verbatim (memory is data, not sanitized at write time), and is only neutralized at the moment it is placed into a model prompt (conversation/prompts.py + safety/prompt_injection.py::sanitise_untrusted).
